integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.lede: Connect your tools so Leadtita can work with your own data.
integrations.description: Pick spreadsheets, docs, CSV or PDF files from your Drive and Leadtita reads them when you ask.
integrations.loadError: We couldn't check your Google connection.
integrations.notConfigured: Integration not configured. Let us know and we'll turn it on.
integrations.hintFiles: You only share the files you pick. You can disconnect at any time.
integrations.hintFull: Leadtita will be able to search your whole Drive (read-only). You can disconnect at any time.
integrations.pickerNotConfigured: The file picker isn't configured yet.
integrations.pickerError: We couldn't open the Google picker. Try again.
integrations.noFiles: You haven't picked any files yet. Add a spreadsheet or a doc to start.
integrations.someRejected: {count, plural, one {# file couldn't be added} other {# files couldn't be added}}: check that you have access and that it's a spreadsheet, doc, CSV or PDF.
integrations.disconnectBody: Drive, Gmail and Calendar disconnect together: Leadtita stops using them and we revoke access on Google. You can reconnect at any time.
integrations.noticeDenied: You cancelled the Google permission. You can try again any time.
integrations.noticeError: We couldn't finish connecting to Google. Try again.

gmail.title: Gmail
gmail.description: Leadtita sends the emails you confirm from your account.
gmail.hint: Send-only permission: we never read your inbox.

calendar.title: Google Calendar
calendar.description: Leadtita books meetings with your leads on your primary calendar.
calendar.hint: Permission to create and edit events; we don't read the rest of your calendar.
